units.source_text: "体育运动到处都是公开的啊。

en.t: "Sports are held openly everywhere, you know.
This is a symbol of the end of the century.

units.source_text: 应该公开的东西，却一点儿也没有公开。

en.t: Yet the things that ought to be public are not made public at all.

units.source_text: 所谓应该公开的东西……也就是死刑。

en.t: What ought to be public, in other words... is the death penalty.
Why is the death penalty not carried out in public?

units.source_text: 你不觉得战争期间的安宁秩序是由于人的死于非命的公开而保持下来的吗？

en.t: Do you not think that the peaceful order during the war was maintained because violent deaths were made public?

units.source_text: 死刑所以不能公开执行，据说是因为考虑到公开执行会使人心充满杀气。

en.t: They say executions cannot be carried out publicly because public executions would fill people's hearts with murderous feeling.
This is a kind of performance.

units.source_text: 在空袭中收拾尸体的人，都是做出一副优雅而快活的样子。

en.t: The people who cleared away corpses during the air raids all put on an elegant and cheerful manner.
